  result=subprocess.run(command(run,state)+cmd,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=out,stderr=err,timeout=180);exitCode=result.returncode;timedOut=False
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:exitCode=None;timedOut=True
